dimensionDefinitions.meaning: Original target use: lexical sense/POS for word study; correct feature use including relevant case/form/agreement for grammar lessons. A label-only mismatch is reported here, not as an English correction failure. A default incomplete message withholds both judgments; licensed replies/commands/reactions are different.
dimensionDefinitions.grammar: Whether the original grammar assessment is justified. Do not infer a grammar error from a target-label mismatch, transport failure or unknown temporal equivalence. For a visibly malformed modal with unknown intended time, needs_work states the known form error and uncertain can responsibly withhold a safe correction; a case may expressly allow both original-grammar labels. The v5 product instruction still prefers uncertain plus no correction and a time question. Label-policy compliance is an auxiliary diagnostic.
dimensionDefinitions.correction: Natural originals remain unchanged, including missing/wrong targets. A correction must be minimal and preserve meaning. Several equivalent corrections can pass. A grammatical modal-perfect alternative with unestablished intended time is uncertain for equivalence, not automatically ungrammatical or critically invented. Responsible withholding passes when correction cannot be chosen safely.
dimensionDefinitions.explanation: Assess only learner-visible factual claims, reviewed application rules and actual comparisons. Hidden model reasons are diagnostic only. A false visible grammar rule fails this dimension even when the correction is right. App-authored explanations do not certify hidden model-text accuracy.
dimensionDefinitions.abstention: Withhold unsafe interpretation/correction and ask for the specific missing message, time, target meaning or relationship. Do not withhold ordinary complete pronouns or valid commands merely because a named real-world referent is absent. Known target-form error can coexist with withheld correction.

criticalPolicy.approveBadGrammar: Learner-visible approval of known incorrect original grammar; a target-only disagreement or unavailable response is not this error.
criticalPolicy.reverseMeaning: Evidence of an actual meaning reversal, not merely an unconfirmed alternative interpretation.
criticalPolicy.swapRoles: Evidence that a visible correction exchanges participants' semantic roles.
criticalPolicy.inventedIntent: Evidence of an invented agent, event or speech act in the visible product output. A model's raw invention that the product independently withholds is a separate model diagnostic.

threshold.completenessPolicy: Every baseline/candidate model has exactly30 terminal primary attempts; every valid output is cross-graded and author-reviewed. Unavailable or uncertain outcomes remain nonpasses in fixed denominators.

freshEvaluationPrerequisites: Freeze the selected product source, this reviewed rubric version, exact requests, collection order and financial protocol before live collection.
Author genuinely fresh30 cases after the source/policy freeze; public105 development cases and these calibration exercises are not holdout data.
Declare per-case acceptable labels and correction conditions before results. Explain genuine alternatives; do not relax expectations after seeing outputs.
Obtain a new bounded financial authorization for this candidate. Closed aef7d0a authorization and balances do not transfer.
Keep raw grades immutable; partially blind author review is not independent expert certification.
